name: integrity-audit
description: Audit a repository against its OWN declared constitution — invariants (CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md), ADRs, contracts (schemas), executable guards (CI tests, hooks) — to detect drift across six universal classes (enforcement, deployment-value, contract, robustness, duplication, hygiene) and, on demand, remediate at the root cause with a derived guard so the class cannot recur. Three modes: AUDIT (report with citations), REMEDIATE (fix lot by lot, gate green between lots), REALIGN (diff-scoped: check current work against the core design). Horizontal: any language, any repo.
